basics.name: Ben Weibel
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Systems Engineer
basics.summary: Senior full-stack software engineer with 15+ years of experience building, modernizing, and supporting data-driven web applications, APIs, and production systems. Strong background in JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, PHP, SQL, REST APIs, Linux environments, Git workflows, and legacy system modernization. Experienced translating stakeholder requirements into maintainable software, improving existing codebases, documenting technical decisions, and supporting long-lived systems where reliability, data quality, and operational continuity matter.

work.name: Wordfence
highlights: Investigate compromised WordPress applications and hosting environments, identifying infection vectors, malicious persistence mechanisms, vulnerable components, and operational impact.
Perform forensic analysis across plugins, themes, server configuration, logs, database artifacts, and third-party integrations to restore application integrity.
Triage vulnerability reports and bug bounty submissions by reproducing issues, validating exploitability, and documenting findings for technical and non-technical audiences.

work.name: Redtail Design Co (Consulting / Return Engagement)
highlights: Provide ongoing full-stack maintenance, modernization, and production support for legacy and active client systems following prior full-time employment.
Improve WordPress-based platforms through targeted performance, security, integration, infrastructure, and maintainability updates.

work.name: Smartz
highlights: Led a small development team of 2 engineers and 1 intern while coordinating with a web team manager on architecture, implementation planning, code review, release workflows, and production reliability.
Built, maintained, and modernized full-stack web applications across JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, PHP, SQL, REST API integrations, WordPress, Magento, Shopify, and custom application code.

Improved existing and legacy codebases by refactoring application logic, stabilizing integrations, standardizing Git-based deployment workflows, and reducing operational risk across active production systems.
Resolved complex production failures across frontend behavior, backend application code, SQL queries, caching layers, DNS, hosting environments, and third-party services.
Improved performance across production systems by addressing TTFB bottlenecks, inefficient database queries, caching behavior, script overhead, and frontend delivery issues.

work.name: Redtail Design Co (W2 Employment)
highlights: Built and maintained custom CMS-backed applications, structured content systems, administrative workflows, and integrations using PHP, JavaScript, SQL, REST APIs, React, Gutenberg, ACF, and relational database-backed content models.
Developed reusable frontend component patterns and deployment workflows that improved maintainability and consistency across concurrent production projects.
Translated stakeholder requirements into technical plans, estimates, implementation details, and long-term maintenance approaches for active client systems.
Implemented accessibility, semantic markup, responsive UI patterns, and frontend performance improvements across production applications.
Provided ongoing support, documentation, troubleshooting, and release coordination for systems used by non-technical administrative stakeholders.

work.name: Electronic Vision
highlights: Developed and maintained CMS-driven websites, custom frontend functionality, templates, and administrative workflows using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and SQL-backed content systems.
Built and supported WordPress and CMS-based sites for higher-education and organizational clients, including Ohio University-related web properties.
Worked directly with clients and stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize features, explain tradeoffs, and deliver maintainable production web systems.
Supported migrations and modernization efforts from legacy CMS platforms to Drupal-based systems, including content transitions, template redevelopment, and long-term maintenance.

work.name: LiveInteractive
work.summary: Led development of a web and hybrid mobile (iOS/Android) event platform alongside full-time engineering work.
highlights: Built a Django-based REST API backend supporting event data, ticketing workflows, authentication, administrative tooling, and hybrid mobile clients.
Developed hybrid mobile application interfaces using Ionic, integrating backend services for event discovery, user workflows, and production data updates.
Managed deployment, infrastructure, issue triage, and production support for an early-stage data-driven platform.
